ACC-5001.name: JournalNotBalanced
ACC-5001.message: Journal entry debit and credit totals must balance.
ACC-5001.hint: Use at least 3 characters. Letters, digits, symbols, or any combination are accepted.

ACC-5002.name: JournalTooFewLines
ACC-5002.message: A journal entry requires at least two lines.

ACC-5003.name: JournalZeroAmount
ACC-5003.message: A journal entry must have a non-zero amount.

ACC-5004.name: JournalPostingFailed
ACC-5004.message: The journal entry could not be posted.

ACC-5005.name: JournalEntryNotEditable
ACC-5005.message: Only a draft journal entry can be edited. Posted and reversed entries are immutable.
ACC-5005.hint: Reverse the entry and create a corrected one instead.

ACC-5006.name: CreditLimitExceeded
ACC-5006.message: Posting this document would exceed the party credit limit. Limit: {0}; current balance: {1}; document total: {2}.
ACC-5006.hint: Collect a payment, raise the credit limit on the party card, or reduce the document total.

ACC-5007.name: CostCenterAllocationInvalid
ACC-5007.message: The allocation for cost center '{0}' is invalid: its percentages must total 100 and every target must be an active leaf cost center.
ACC-5007.hint: Fix the allocation on the cost center card and post again.

ACC-5008.name: CostCenterNotLeaf
ACC-5008.message: Cost center '{0}' is a group or inactive cost center and cannot receive postings.
ACC-5008.hint: Choose an active leaf cost center, or define an allocation for the group center.

ACC-5009.name: CostCenterUnknown
ACC-5009.message: Cost center '{0}' does not match any active cost center for this company and cannot be posted.
ACC-5009.hint: Create the cost center or correct the code, then post again.

ACC-5010.name: CostCenterRequired
ACC-5010.message: Account '{0}' requires a cost center; the journal line has none.
ACC-5010.hint: Add a cost center to the line, or clear the cost-required flag on the account card.

ACC-5011.name: DocumentPostingAccountMissing
ACC-5011.message: Document posting account '{0}' is missing, inactive, deleted, or not postable for this company.
ACC-5011.hint: Create or activate a postable account with that code in the chart of accounts, then post again.

ACC-5012.name: DocumentAlreadyPostedToGl
ACC-5012.message: Document '{0}' already has a posted general-ledger entry and cannot be posted twice.
ACC-5012.hint: Reverse the existing journal entry before posting the document again.

ACC-5013.name: DocumentTotalMismatch
ACC-5013.message: Document '{0}' stored total {1} does not match the total recomputed from its lines ({2}); posting uses the stored total.
ACC-5013.hint: Check the document's header discount and extra charges; correct the stored document if the stored total is wrong.

ACC-5014.name: DocumentKindNotPostable
ACC-5014.message: Document kind '{0}' cannot be posted through the invoice posting path.
ACC-5014.hint: Use the dedicated window for this document kind (stock transfers and stock counts post through the warehouse engines), or check the document kind.

ACC-5015.name: ExchangeRateMissing
ACC-5015.message: No exchange rate is available for currency '{0}': the document carries no rate and no master rate exists on or before {1}.
ACC-5015.hint: Enter a rate on the document, or maintain a dated rate for the currency in the currency card, then post again.

ACC-5016.name: BankStatementNotReconciled
ACC-5016.message: The bank statement cannot be closed while its difference is not zero.
ACC-5016.hint: Match the remaining statement lines to book lines (or post the missing book entries) until the difference is zero.

ACC-5017.name: StatementLineAlreadyMatched
ACC-5017.message: The statement line is already matched to a book line.
ACC-5017.hint: Unmatch the statement line before matching it to a different book line.

AUTH-2001.name: InvalidCredentials
AUTH-2001.message: The username or password is incorrect
AUTH-2001.hint: Check the username and password and try again.

AUTH-2002.name: AccountLocked
AUTH-2002.message: This account is locked. Sign-in was refused.
AUTH-2002.hint: Wait until the lockout period ends or ask an administrator to unlock the account.

AUTH-2003.name: AccountLockedNow
AUTH-2003.message: The account was locked after repeated failed sign-in attempts.
AUTH-2003.hint: Wait until the lockout period ends or ask an administrator to unlock the account.

AUTH-2004.name: PasswordPolicyViolation
AUTH-2004.message: Administrator password does not meet the password policy: {0}
AUTH-2004.hint: Use at least 3 characters. Letters, digits, symbols, or any combination are accepted.

AUTH-2005.name: PermissionDenied
AUTH-2005.message: You do not have permission to perform this operation.
AUTH-2005.hint: Ask an administrator to grant the required permission.

AUTH-2006.name: PermissionLoadFailed
AUTH-2006.message: The signed-in user's permissions could not be loaded.
AUTH-2006.hint: Sign in again; if the problem persists, check the company database.

CO-3001.name: CompanyRecordNotFound
CO-3001.message: The local company record required to open this company was not found.
CO-3001.hint: The company list on this computer is out of date. Reindex companies or restore the company data.

CO-3002.name: CompanyDatabasePathMissing
CO-3002.message: Company database path is not set.
CO-3002.hint: Edit the company and set its database path.

CO-3003.name: PostgresDatabaseNameMissing
CO-3003.message: PostgreSQL database name is not set.

CO-3004.name: PostgresConnectionMissing
CO-3004.message: Current PostgreSQL connection is not available.

CO-3007.name: CompanyCoaTemplateNotFound
CO-3007.message: The selected chart of accounts template could not be found.
CO-3007.hint: Pick another chart of accounts template, or restore the template files in the Resources/COA folder.

DATA-4001.name: ExportPermissionDenied
DATA-4001.message: You do not have permission to export data (DATA.EXPORT).
DATA-4001.hint: Ask an administrator to grant the DATA.EXPORT permission.

DATA-4002.name: ExportFailed
DATA-4002.message: The export could not be completed.

DATA-4003.name: ImportFailed
DATA-4003.message: The import could not be completed.

DB-1001.name: DatabaseConnectionFailed
DB-1001.message: Could not connect to the database.
DB-1001.hint: Check that the database server is running and the connection settings are correct.

DB-1002.name: DatabaseFileMissing
DB-1002.hint: The company database file may have been moved or deleted. Restore it from a backup or re-create the company.

DB-1004.name: DatabaseNotInitialized
DB-1004.message: Company database file is not properly initialized.
DB-1004.hint: The file exists but is not a valid company database. Restore from a backup or re-create the company.

INV-6001.name: InventoryOperationFailed
INV-6001.message: The inventory operation could not be completed.

INV-6002.name: StockValuationFailed
INV-6002.hint: Check the material cost method and stock balance, then post again.

INV-6003.name: RecalculationFailed
INV-6003.hint: See the job record in stock_revaluation_jobs for the error, fix the cause, and run the job again.

INV-6004.name: RecalculationClosedPeriod
INV-6004.message: Recalculate Costs cannot rewrite movements in a closed fiscal period (from date '{0}').
INV-6004.hint: Choose a from date inside an open fiscal period.

INV-6005.name: BatchSerialRequired
INV-6005.message: Batch or serial data is required to post material '{0}'.
INV-6005.hint: Capture the batch (with expiry) or the serial numbers for the line, then post again.

INV-6006.name: BatchStockInsufficient
INV-6006.message: Batch '{0}' does not hold enough stock for material '{1}'.
INV-6006.hint: Choose another batch or reduce the quantity, then post again.

INV-6007.name: SerialUnavailable
INV-6007.message: Serial '{0}' is not available in stock for material '{1}'.
INV-6007.hint: Only serials in stock at the document warehouse can be issued; check the serial status and warehouse.

INV-6008.name: SerialDuplicate
INV-6008.hint: Serial numbers are unique per material; correct the number and post again.

INV-6009.name: BatchAllocationMismatch
INV-6009.message: The batch/serial allocations do not match the movement quantity for material '{0}'.
INV-6009.hint: Allocate exactly the line quantity across batches, or exactly one serial per unit.

INV-6010.name: BatchExpired
INV-6010.message: Batch '{0}' for material '{1}' expired on {2} and cannot be issued.
INV-6010.hint: Choose a batch that has not expired, or post with the expired-batch override permission (the override is recorded).

LIC-8001.name: LicenseCheckFailed
LIC-8001.message: The license could not be verified.

SYS-0001.name: UnknownError
SYS-0001.hint: If the problem continues, note the error code and contact support.

SYS-0002.name: DispatcherUnhandled
SYS-0002.message: An unexpected error interrupted the current operation.
SYS-0002.hint: If the problem continues, note the error code and contact support.

SYS-0003.name: AppDomainUnhandled
SYS-0003.message: An unexpected error occurred in the application.

SYS-0005.name: NonFatalInternalFailure
SYS-0005.message: A non-critical internal operation failed and was recovered.

SYS-0006.name: ConfigurationLoadFailed
SYS-0006.message: The application configuration could not be loaded.

SYS-0007.name: FileAccessFailed
SYS-0007.message: A file could not be accessed.

SYS-0010.name: SettingsLoadFailed
SYS-0010.message: Settings could not be loaded; defaults were used.

UI-7001.name: WindowOperationFailed
UI-7001.message: The window operation could not be completed.

UI-7002.name: ShellOperationFailed
UI-7002.message: A main window operation could not be completed.

UI-7003.name: WindowLoadFailed
UI-7003.message: The window could not be loaded.

DATA-4004.name: ImportPermissionDenied
DATA-4004.message: You do not have permission to import data (DATA.IMPORT).
DATA-4004.hint: Ask an administrator to grant the DATA.IMPORT permission.

DATA-4005.name: BalanceImportNotAllowed
DATA-4005.message: Balances and stock quantities cannot be imported from a spreadsheet. They change only through posted stock movements.
DATA-4005.hint: Post an opening-stock or adjustment document instead, or restore a .stei package.

DATA-4006.name: DocumentImportRequiresPackage
DATA-4006.message: Documents and journal entries cannot be imported from a spreadsheet. Exchange them as an encrypted .stei dataset package.
DATA-4006.hint: Export the dataset as a .stei package and import that package instead.

ACC-5018.name: BudgetExceededAnnual
ACC-5018.message: Posting this entry would exceed the annual budget '{0}'. Limit: {1}; actual before this entry: {2}; this entry: {3}; overage: {4}.
ACC-5018.hint: Reduce the entry, move the amount to another account or cost center, or raise the budget line in the Budgets window.

ACC-5019.name: BudgetExceededMonthly
ACC-5019.message: Posting this entry would exceed the accumulated monthly budget '{0}' through this month. Limit: {1}; actual before this entry: {2}; this entry: {3}; overage: {4}.
ACC-5019.hint: Reduce the entry, post it in a later month, or adjust the monthly distribution in the Budgets window.

INV-6011.name: QualityGateBlocked
INV-6011.message: A rejected quality inspection blocks document '{1}' for material '{0}'.
INV-6011.hint: Resolve the failed inspection's alert (root cause and corrective action) or complete a new inspection before posting.

INV-6012.name: QualityQuarantinedSale
INV-6012.message: Material '{0}' is in quarantine awaiting quality inspection and cannot be sold in Stop gate mode (document '{1}').
INV-6012.hint: Complete the pending quality inspection to release the stock, or switch the company QC gate mode to Warn.

INV-6013.name: QualityOutgoingInspectionRequired
INV-6013.message: Material '{0}' requires an accepted outgoing quality inspection before document '{1}' can be delivered (Stop gate mode).
INV-6013.hint: Create and complete an outgoing inspection for the document, or switch the company QC gate mode to Warn.

INV-6014.name: QualityInspectionStateInvalid
INV-6014.message: The quality inspection for document '{0}' cannot change state from '{1}'.
INV-6014.hint: Refresh the inspection list; only a Draft inspection can be edited or completed.

INV-6015.name: QualityInspectionQtyMismatch
INV-6015.message: Accepted and rejected quantities for document '{0}' do not add up to the inspected quantity, or the disposition is missing.
INV-6015.hint: Enter accepted and rejected quantities that sum to the inspected quantity and choose a disposition for the rejected part.

INV-6016.name: QualityTemplateInvalid
INV-6016.hint: Check the template lines: numeric parameters need a band, value parameters need an accepted value, and a parameter may appear only once.

CRM-9001.name: CrmLeadAlreadyConverted
CRM-9001.hint: A converted lead keeps its party and opportunity links; create a new lead or work with the converted party.

CRM-9002.name: CrmLeadStateInvalid
CRM-9002.message: Lead '{0}' cannot change state as requested.
CRM-9002.hint: Unqualified leads cannot be converted, and a lead becomes Converted only through conversion.

CRM-9003.name: CrmOpportunityStageInvalid
CRM-9003.hint: Configure the pipeline stages for the company, then retry the move.

CRM-9004.name: CrmQuotationPartyMissing
CRM-9004.message: A quotation cannot be created for '{0}'.
CRM-9004.hint: Link the opportunity to a customer party (or convert its lead) and make sure the company record resolves before creating a quotation.

CRM-9005.name: CrmActivityTargetInvalid
CRM-9005.message: Activity '{0}' must target exactly one of a lead, an opportunity or a party.
CRM-9005.hint: Pick exactly one target for the activity.

CRM-9006.name: CrmLostReasonRequired
CRM-9006.message: A lost reason is required when opportunity '{0}' is marked lost.
CRM-9006.hint: Choose a lost reason (configure reasons in the pipeline window if the list is empty).

MFG-1001.name: BomCycleDetected
MFG-1001.message: Bill of materials for '{0}' references itself directly or through other bills of materials; the cycle must be removed before the BOM can be used.
MFG-1001.hint: Open the BOM and remove the component that (transitively) produces the finished material itself.

MFG-1002.name: BomNotFoundOrInactive
MFG-1002.message: Bill of materials '{0}' was not found or is not active for this company.
MFG-1002.hint: Activate the BOM version in the BOM window or choose another version.

MFG-1003.name: MfgOrderStageInvalid
MFG-1003.message: Manufacturing order '{0}' cannot perform this action in status '{1}'.
MFG-1003.hint: Follow the staged workflow: Draft, Confirmed, In Process, Completed, Closed (or Cancelled).

MFG-1004.name: MfgIssueExceedsRequired
MFG-1004.message: Issuing {1} of '{0}' would exceed the required quantity on the order.
MFG-1004.hint: Issue at most the remaining required quantity, or edit the draft order lines first.

MFG-1005.name: MfgFinishExceedsPlanned
MFG-1005.message: Receiving {1} of '{0}' would exceed the planned production quantity.
MFG-1005.hint: Receive at most the remaining planned quantity.

MFG-1006.name: PlanningConversionInvalid
MFG-1006.message: Planning row '{0}' cannot be converted in status '{1}'.
MFG-1006.hint: Only Planned orders and Suggested purchase rows can be converted, exactly once.

HR-1001.name: HrEmployeeCodeDuplicate
HR-1001.message: Employee code '{0}' already exists for this company.

HR-1002.name: HrEmployeeInvalid
HR-1002.message: Employee '{0}' has invalid data and cannot be saved.
HR-1002.hint: Check the employee card fields and save again.

HR-1003.name: HrLeaveBalanceInsufficient
HR-1003.message: Leave balance is insufficient for '{0}': the requested days exceed the available balance.
HR-1003.hint: Allocate more days, reduce the request, or approve with the balance-override permission.

HR-1004.name: HrLeaveStateInvalid
HR-1004.message: The leave application cannot change state from '{0}'.
HR-1004.hint: Refresh the list and check the application status.

HR-1005.name: HrPayrollAlreadyPosted
HR-1005.hint: Reverse the run before regenerating or editing it.

HR-1006.name: HrPayrollStateInvalid
HR-1006.message: Payroll run '{0}' is not in a state that allows this operation.
HR-1006.hint: Refresh the run list and check the run status.

HR-1007.name: HrSalaryStructureInvalid
HR-1007.hint: Check the structure lines, components and accounts.

HR-1008.name: HrMasterInUse
HR-1008.message: This record is still referenced by other data and cannot be deleted.
HR-1008.hint: Remove the references first, or deactivate the record instead.

HR-1009.name: HrEmployeeNotPayable
HR-1009.message: Employee '{0}' is terminated and cannot receive a salary assignment or payroll.
HR-1009.hint: Re-activate the employee first if this is a correction.

HR-1010.name: HrMasterCodeDuplicate
HR-1010.message: Code '{0}' already exists for this company.

POS-1001.name: PosNoOpenSession
POS-1001.message: No POS session is open for this sale.
POS-1001.hint: Open a session on the terminal, or enable session-less selling in POS settings with the bypass permission.

POS-1002.name: PosSessionAlreadyOpen
POS-1002.message: Terminal '{0}' already has an open session.
POS-1002.hint: Close the open session before opening another on the same terminal.

POS-1003.name: PosSessionStateInvalid
POS-1003.message: The POS session state does not allow this operation.
POS-1003.hint: Check the session is open (for closing, counted cash is required and cannot be negative).

POS-1004.name: PosTenderMismatch
POS-1004.message: The tenders do not settle the bill exactly.
POS-1004.hint: Adjust cash, card and on-account amounts so the applied tenders equal the bill total; over-tendered cash is change.

POS-1005.name: PosTenderInvalid
POS-1005.hint: Check tender types and amounts: card cannot over-tender, on-account needs a named customer, amounts cannot be negative.

POS-1006.name: PosReturnExceedsSold
POS-1006.message: The return quantity exceeds what the original bill still has returnable.
POS-1006.hint: Reduce the return quantity to the sold minus already-returned quantity.

POS-1007.name: PosReturnOriginalInvalid
POS-1007.message: The original POS bill for this return is invalid or was not found.
POS-1007.hint: Load a posted POS bill of the current company before returning against it.

POS-1008.name: PosHeldBillNotFound
POS-1008.message: The held bill was not found.
POS-1008.hint: Refresh the held bills list and pick the bill again.

POS-1009.name: PosHeldBillStateInvalid
POS-1009.message: The held bill is not in a state that allows this operation.
POS-1009.hint: Only a bill still in Held state can be recalled or cancelled.

POS-1010.name: PosSessionlessNotAllowed
POS-1010.message: Session-less selling is enabled but this user may not bypass sessions.
POS-1010.hint: Ask an administrator for the POS.SESSION.BYPASS permission, or open a session.

CRM-9007.name: CrmDuplicateLeadOrParty
CRM-9007.message: A lead or customer with the same email or phone already exists: '{0}'.
CRM-9007.hint: Link the existing record instead of creating a duplicate.

CRM-9008.name: CrmOpportunityItemInvalid
CRM-9008.message: Opportunity item '{0}' must have a quantity greater than zero and a non-negative price.
CRM-9008.hint: Correct the item quantity and price, then save again.

SAL-7001.name: ChainSourceNotPosted
SAL-7001.message: The source document '{0}' must be posted before it can be converted.
SAL-7001.hint: Post the source document, then convert it.

SAL-7002.name: ChainQuantityExceedsRemaining
SAL-7002.message: The requested quantity for '{0}' exceeds the remaining quantity on the source document.
SAL-7002.hint: Reduce the quantity to the remaining amount shown on the source document.

SAL-7003.name: ChainSourceFullyFulfilled
SAL-7003.message: The source document '{0}' is already fully fulfilled.
SAL-7003.hint: Choose another source document, or close this one.

SAL-7004.name: ChainTransitionNotAllowed
SAL-7004.message: Documents cannot be converted from '{0}' to '{1}'.
SAL-7004.hint: Follow the chain: quotation to order, order to delivery, delivery to invoice.

SAL-7005.name: ChainReversalBlockedDownstream
SAL-7005.message: Document '{0}' cannot be reversed while posted downstream documents are linked to it.
SAL-7005.hint: Reverse or cancel the downstream documents first.

SAL-7006.name: ChainReversalBlockedPayments
SAL-7006.message: Document '{0}' cannot be reversed while payments are allocated to it.
SAL-7006.hint: Unallocate the payments first, then reverse the document.

SAL-7007.name: ChainDocumentNotReversible
SAL-7007.message: Document '{0}' cannot be reversed in its current state.
SAL-7007.hint: Only a posted delivery note or sales invoice in the document chain can be reversed.

SAL-7008.name: QuotationExpired
SAL-7008.message: Quotation '{0}' expired on {1} and can no longer be converted.
SAL-7008.hint: Create a new quotation, or extend the validity of this one before it expires.

SAL-7009.name: DeliveryCostAllocationFailed
SAL-7009.message: The delivery cost for document '{0}' could not be allocated to this invoice.
SAL-7009.hint: Check that the delivery is posted and its stock movements carry cost, then post again.

SAL-7010.name: AllocationExceedsOpenAmount
SAL-7010.message: The allocation exceeds the open amount of document '{0}'.
SAL-7010.hint: Reduce the allocation to the open amount shown for the document.

SAL-7011.name: StockReservationInvalid
SAL-7011.message: The reservation for '{0}' exceeds the available stock.
SAL-7011.hint: Reduce the reserved quantity to the available quantity.

SAL-7012.name: PickingExceedsRemaining
SAL-7012.message: The picked quantity for '{0}' exceeds the remaining quantity to deliver.
SAL-7012.hint: Reduce the picked quantity to the remaining amount on the order.

SAL-7013.name: CommissionPolicyInvalid
SAL-7013.message: Commission policy '{0}' is invalid or incomplete.
SAL-7013.hint: Complete the policy basis, rate and validity period, then save again.

SAL-7014.name: CommissionSettlementInvalid
SAL-7014.message: Commission settlement '{0}' cannot be processed in its current state.
SAL-7014.hint: Approve the commission entries before settling them.

SAL-7015.name: ContractQuantityExceeded
SAL-7015.message: The quantity for '{0}' exceeds the remaining contracted quantity.
SAL-7015.hint: Reduce the quantity to the remaining amount under the contract.

SAL-7016.name: ApprovalStateInvalid
SAL-7016.message: Document '{0}' cannot change approval state from its current state.
SAL-7016.hint: Refresh the document and check its approval status before acting.

ACC-5020.name: Party blacklisted
ACC-5020.message: The party is blacklisted and cannot be used on new documents.

SAL-7017.name: Document revision conflict
SAL-7017.message: The document was changed by a newer revision; reload it before saving.

SAL-7018.name: Price below minimum
SAL-7018.message: The selling price is below the material's minimum price and no authorized override was supplied.

SAL-7019.name: Margin below minimum
SAL-7019.message: The selling price yields a margin below the material's target margin and no authorized override was supplied.

SAL-7020.name: Discount exceeds limit
SAL-7020.message: The discount exceeds the material's maximum discount percentage and no authorized override was supplied.

SAL-7021.name: Return quantity exceeded
SAL-7021.message: The returned quantity exceeds the remaining returnable quantity on the source document line.

SAL-7022.name: Return inspection required
SAL-7022.message: This return requires an inspection decision before it can be posted.

SAL-7023.name: Contract inactive or expired
SAL-7023.message: The sales contract is not active for this document date; expired, suspended or not-yet-effective contracts cannot be drawn down.

SAL-7024.name: Recurring schedule invalid
SAL-7024.message: The recurring schedule is invalid: a template document, a positive interval and a next-run date are required.

SAL-7025.name: RMA state invalid
SAL-7025.message: The RMA request is not in a state that allows this operation.

SAL-7026.name: Warranty claim invalid
SAL-7026.message: The warranty claim is invalid: the warranty is expired, void, or does not cover this claim.

SAL-7027.name: Settlement discount invalid
SAL-7027.message: The settlement discount is invalid: it exceeds the document's open amount or was not authorized.

SAL-7028.name: Cross-currency allocation invalid
SAL-7028.message: The cross-currency allocation is invalid: the document amount, payment amount or exchange rates are inconsistent.

SAL-7029.name: Consolidation mismatch
SAL-7029.message: The deliveries cannot be consolidated into one invoice: party, currency or exchange rate differ, or a source is not a delivery.

PUR-1001.name: RequisitionNotEditable
PUR-1001.message: A requisition can only be edited before submission or after rejection.
PUR-1001.hint: Correct it after a rejection, or create a new requisition instead.

PUR-1002.name: RequisitionCancelBlocked
PUR-1002.message: A requisition that has been converted, closed, or already cancelled cannot be cancelled.
PUR-1002.hint: Once conversion is complete, close the requisition instead.

PUR-1003.name: RequisitionCloseInvalid
PUR-1003.message: Only a fully converted requisition can be closed.
PUR-1003.hint: Convert the requisition to a purchase order or a request for quotation first.

PUR-1004.name: RequisitionStateInvalid
PUR-1004.message: The requisition state does not allow this operation.
PUR-1004.hint: Reload the requisition and check its workflow status.

PUR-1005.name: RequisitionReasonRequired
PUR-1005.message: A reason is required for this requisition action.
PUR-1005.hint: Type the reason in the decision reason field.

PUR-1006.name: LandedCostAlreadyBookedNeedsAccount
PUR-1006.message: Landed-cost charge '{0}' is marked AlreadyBooked but has no expense account.
PUR-1006.hint: Enter the expense account the charge was already booked to, or switch the charge credit mode back to Payable.

PUR-1007.name: LandedCostPayeeNotFound
PUR-1007.message: Landed-cost charge '{0}' names payee party {1}, which is not an active party of this company.
PUR-1007.hint: Pick the payee from the company party list, or clear the payee to owe the receipt supplier.

PUR-1008.name: LandedCostReceiptSelectionInvalid
PUR-1008.message: The landed-cost voucher selects no eligible receipt lines.
PUR-1008.hint: Select at least one posted goods receipt and include at least one stock-valued receipt line.

PUR-1009.name: LandedCostDocumentAlreadyLinked
PUR-1009.message: Supplier document {1} is already consumed by posted landed-cost voucher '{0}'.
PUR-1009.hint: A supplier document can be linked to only one posted landed-cost voucher. Reverse that voucher first, or link a different document.

PUR-1010.name: LandedCostLinkedDocumentInvalid
PUR-1010.message: Charge '{0}' cannot link to supplier document {1}.
PUR-1010.hint: Link a posted supplier document in the same currency whose journal debits exactly one cost account; the charge amount may not exceed that debit.

PUR-1012.name: AdvancePurchaseOrderMismatch
PUR-1012.message: Supplier advance cannot be applied to '{0}': the purchase order does not match.
PUR-1012.hint: An advance settles only invoices of the purchase order it was paid against, for the same supplier in the same company. Check the advance's purchase order and the invoice's order chain.

PUR-1013.name: AdvanceReversalBlockedWhileConsumed
PUR-1013.message: Supplier advance '{0}' is partly consumed and cannot be reversed.
PUR-1013.hint: Reverse the advance allocations in Payment Reconciliation first; the advance voucher can be reversed once none of it is consumed.

PUR-1011.name: SupplierBillReferenceDuplicate
PUR-1011.message: Supplier bill '{0}' already exists for this supplier on invoice {1}.
PUR-1011.hint: A supplier bill number may be used only once per supplier. Check the existing invoice, or correct the bill number / bill date from the supplier's document.

PUR-1014.name: WithholdingConfigurationInvalid
PUR-1014.message: Withholding rule '{0}' has no valid withholding payable account.
PUR-1014.hint: Configure a postable liability account on the withholding tax rule (Tax Configuration), or clear the withholding code from the document.

PUR-1015.name: WithholdingExceedsPayable
PUR-1015.message: Withholding {1} on invoice '{0}' exceeds the amount payable to the supplier.
PUR-1015.hint: Withholding is deducted from the supplier's payable and can never exceed it. Check the withholding rate and base.

PUR-1016.name: WithholdingRuleNotFound
PUR-1016.message: Withholding tax code '{0}' has no active withholding rule for this company on the document date.
PUR-1016.hint: Create or activate a withholding tax rule with this code in Tax Configuration, or remove the withholding code from the document.

DSG-8101.name: DesignFileInvalid
DSG-8101.message: The file '{0}' is not a valid ShouTech design file, or it has been modified or corrupted.
DSG-8101.hint: Export the design again from its designer window, and make sure the file was not changed after export.

DSG-8102.name: DesignFileKindMismatch
DSG-8102.message: The design file '{0}' belongs to a different designer and cannot be imported here.
DSG-8102.hint: Open the designer that matches the file type (.strd report, .stid invoice, .stld label) and import the file there.

DSG-8103.name: DesignPayloadInvalid
DSG-8103.message: The design file '{0}' was read but its contents are not a usable design.
DSG-8103.hint: Re-export the design from a current version of the program, then import it again.
